::: tip Usage

1. Download and Install

   Choose the appropriate installation package for your operating system and complete the installation.

2. Import the Configuration

   Click the desired link from the list above. The Clash client will open automatically and import the configuration.

3. Activate the Configuration

   Open the Clash client and verify that the new profile has been added successfully. Select it as the active profile if necessary.

4. Enable the Proxy

   Start the proxy service in the Clash client and enable the system proxy to route your network traffic through Clash.

:::
